senses.gloss:
ऊधस् n.
1 An udder (changed to
ऊधन् in Bah. comp.); भुवं कोष्णेन
कुंडोध्नी मेध्येनावभृथादपि R. 1. 84.
--2 A
covered secret place to which only
friends are admitted.
--3 The bosom.
--4 The breast of a mother.

ऊधन्यं or ऊधस्यं Milk (produced
from the udder); ऊधस्यमिच्छामि
तवोपभोक्तुं R. 2. 66.
